text: This recipe, Tibetan Greens With Tofu, is a great fit for you because it meets your dietary requirements as a vegan and also supports your goal of consuming higher protein. The dish is made with firm tofu, which is an excellent source of protein, and is combined with swiss chard, a nutrient-rich leafy green. The recipe is also quick to prepare, taking only about 20 minutes, which fits within your time budget of 45 minutes or less.
